"""Replayable, nine-stroke brush copy of 信. Paths are lengthwise and vary pressure.
The adjacent fitted_paths.npz stores sheet X/Y and press depth, all in millimetres.
"""
import os, sys, time, json
os.environ['RCB_RENDER']='0'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from fit import samples

def generate(pathfile='/app/output/fitted_paths.npz',outfile='/app/output/trajectory.npz'):
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False)
 p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
 paths=np.load(pathfile)
 actual=[];desired=[]
 for i in range(9):
  nodes=paths[str(i)]
  p['move_tip']([*s.tip_pose()[0][:2],.06],speed=.06,settle=3)
  p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.12,settle=3)
  p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.03,settle=5)
  p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.055],speed=.05,settle=3)
  xy=np.array(s.geo.mm_to_world(*nodes[0,:2]))
  # Align the gathered brush with the first written direction in the air.
  direction=nodes[1,:2]-nodes[0,:2];direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
  pre=np.array(s.geo.mm_to_world(*(nodes[0,:2]-3*direction)))
  p['move_tip']([*pre,.035],speed=.1,settle=3)
  p['move_tip']([*xy,.023],speed=.012,settle=5)
  a=samples(nodes,ds=.35)
  # PD lead compensates the roughly two-control-step tracking delay.
  xyz=np.array([[*s.geo.mm_to_world(*pt[:2]),.020-pt[2]/1000] for pt in a])
  # Descend to the start surface before the continuous writing motion.
  p['move_tip'](xyz[0],speed=.005,settle=3)
  for j,pos in enumerate(xyz):
   velocity=(xyz[min(j+1,len(xyz)-1)]-xyz[max(j-1,0)])/2
   cmd=pos+1.5*velocity
   q,ok,err=s.ik(cmd)
   if not ok: raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,j,err))
   s.step(q)
   actual.append(s.tip_pose()[0]);desired.append(pos)
  p['move_tip']([*xyz[-1,:2],.035],speed=.012,settle=5)
  print('stroke',i,'steps',s.n_steps,'elapsed',time.time(),flush=True)
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png')
 p['move_tip']([*s.tip_pose()[0][:2],.06],speed=.04,settle=10)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,outfile)
 np.savez('/app/output/tracking.npz',actual=actual,desired=desired)
 import pickle
 with open('/app/output/strokes.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump(s.strokes(),f)
 print('state_sha',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 print(json.dumps(s.score(),indent=2),flush=True)
 return s
if __name__=='__main__':
 generate(*sys.argv[1:])
EOF
